criteria.detail: top=0.382 SD vs control=0.199 SD (ratio 1.91x); paired difference +0.182 SD, lineage-clustered 95% CI [-0.020, +0.530] over 3 lineages; scope: repeatable implementations only (hh_cable, migliore_ca1, pospischil_rs). descriptive.detail: baseline=0.135, 8 classes, cv=stratified_5fold. Withdrawn as an H-B criterion by the 2026-08-06 audit (7.5): random within-table splits of derived rows from one campaign measure dataset fingerprinting, not independent biological identity.

descriptive.quantity: adjusted ICC of model identity (mixed model, descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: not scored: the fixed covariates are the H-G hypothesis, so the residual between-family share is not a fair test of H-B

descriptive.quantity: top-tuple Jaccard, Gaussian vs Gaussian-copula (descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: 8 models over 31 ensemble cells, min per-model 0.67. Withdrawn as an H-B criterion by the 2026-08-06 audit (M6): both rankings come from Gaussian estimators on the SAME samples -- the copula transform only removes marginal non-Gaussianity -- so agreement between them measures estimator similarity, not module stability. Stability across independent samples is what blueprint 19.3 asks for and what the campaign-scramble replicate now supplies.

descriptive.quantity: top vs random control point ratio (descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: top=0.382 SD vs control=0.118 SD (ratio 3.25x); paired difference +0.264 SD, lineage-clustered 95% CI [+0.022, +0.677] over 3 lineages; scope: repeatable implementations only (hh_cable, migliore_ca1, pospischil_rs). Not scored: same measurement as the criterion above with a different denominator.

perturbation_precondition.rule: perturbation-derived H-B criteria are scored only on implementations whose per-background eta is numerically repeatable at half the campaign time step
perturbation_precondition.provenance: added 2026-08-09 in response to the independent post-response audit, with the 2/5 repeatability outcome already known. The repeatability RULE it consumes was prespecified in perturbation_inference.py before the half-step run; the minimum lineage count is new and is set by what a clustered bootstrap can estimate.
perturbation_precondition.definition: per-background eta recomputed at half the campaign dt; repeatable = median |delta eta| <= 0.05 feature SD AND >= 80% of tuple means keep their sign

perturbation_coverage.caveat: the perturbation criteria in this arm are computed without ['mainen_l5pc']; their conclusion cannot be compared with an arm that has complete coverage

arm_description: mainen_l5pc retained despite its N3 failure, to show how much the exclusion moves the result

excluded_from_primary.mainen_l5pc: production dt=0.0125 ms / 2304 segments fails step_abs_hi.adaptation_index at 1 of 7 audit points; the other 12 conditioning features reproduce on all 7

effective_sample.cohort_label: N3-passing; N4 unresolved for bbp_l5pc, tomko_ca1
effective_sample.note: clustering, folds and bootstraps use source_lineage_id, not model_id; the two differ and the difference is the whole point of the 2026-08-06 audit's finding 4
